settings.title: Fast, reliable hosting. Real Perth support.

settings.editor: Website hosting (cPanel), WordPress hosting we look after for you, and reseller hosting for agencies. All on Perth servers our team monitors around the clock.

settings.title: Which hosting is right for you?
You manage your own website and just need somewhere solid to host it.

settings.editor: Full control over your site via the industry-standard cPanel dashboard. Ideal for a single, self-managed website.

settings.title: You've got a website, but you'd rather leave the technical side to us.

settings.editor: We handle setup, updates and troubleshooting, so you can focus on the business instead of the server. Perfect for your WordPress website.
Looking for reseller hosting, or need a private server (VPS)? Dedicated and VPS hosting is coming soon. Join the waitlist.

settings.title: What's included, no matter which plan.

settings.editor: Every site is secured with HTTPS from day one, at no extra cost.
Automatic daily backups, so a bad update is never a disaster.
Monitored around the clock from right here in Perth.
We move your site, email and domain across at no charge.
Your site runs on servers we monitor ourselves, not a support ticket routed through three time zones. If something goes wrong, you call a real Perth number and talk to someone who can fix it.
Here's what business owners say after switching.
20 plus years dealing with hosting companies, and recently moved to PWH. The quality of the hosting and service is the best I have experienced.

So far THE BEST client support I have ever seen. Cameron was very patient with me and went out of his way to answer all of my questions. The web hosting transfer was actioned smoothly with no downtime.
Absolutely top notch service, brilliant support. There is no problems, only solutions.

tabs.tab_title: What's the difference between cPanel, semi-managed and reseller hosting?
tabs.tab_content: cPanel gives you full control and you manage everything yourself. Semi-managed means we handle the setup, updates and troubleshooting so you don’t have to. Reseller hosting is for anyone managing sites for clients, with your own branding and full account control.

tabs.tab_title: Can you migrate my existing website across?
tabs.tab_content: Yes, for free. We migrate your files, databases and email, and most sites move across with no downtime.

tabs.tab_title: How much storage do I get?
tabs.tab_content: It depends on the plan: 5GB to 30GB of high-speed SSD storage on cPanel and semi-managed WordPress plans, and 25GB to 75GB on reseller plans. You can switch plans any time as you grow.

tabs.tab_title: Is a domain included with hosting?
tabs.tab_content: Domains are registered separately. Search for your domain, and we'll connect it to your hosting for you.

tabs.tab_title: What happens if my site goes down?
tabs.tab_content: Our servers are monitored around the clock from right here in Perth, so we're usually already on it. If you need us, call a real Perth number, 08 6365 4522, and talk to someone who can fix it.

settings.title: Switching is easier than you think.

settings.editor: We migrate your files, databases and email for free. Most sites move across with no downtime.
